name: chat_moderation
title: Community chat moderation
description: Moderate messages in a gaming or community chat: allowed or not, why, and what to do.
writes: a single message posted in an online gaming or hobby community chat

ask: Does this message break typical community rules?
Should a moderator act on this message?

labels.yes: harassment, hate, threats, doxxing, scams or spam
labels.no: fine, including banter, mild swearing and criticism

ask: What kind of message is this?

labels.harassment: insults or pile-ons aimed at a person
labels.personal_info: someone's real name, address or contact

labels.mute: remove and mute for a while
